title: SKU Feature Map
description: Schema for sku-feature-map.json — maps M365 SKU tiers to feature groups, service plans, and CheckID detection checks for licensing gap analysis.

$schema.description: Reference to this JSON Schema file for editor validation.

version.description: Semantic version of the SKU feature map data.

featureGroups.description: Map of feature group identifiers to their definitions. Each group represents a logical capability tied to service plans and CheckID checks.

skuTiers.description: Map of SKU tier identifiers (e.g., E3, E5) to their included service plans.

displayName.description: Human-readable name of the feature group.

description.description: Brief explanation of what this feature group provides.

category.description: Functional category this feature group belongs to.

servicePlans.description: M365 service plan identifiers that enable this feature group.

detectionChecks.description: CheckID identifiers that detect whether this feature group is properly configured.

valueCategory.description: Primary value dimension this feature group delivers.

estimatedEffort.description: Estimated implementation effort for enabling this feature group.

quickWin.description: Whether this feature group can be enabled quickly with minimal risk.

includedPlans.description: Service plan identifiers included in this SKU tier.
